ios.desc:
Connect with people through your favorite places!

With HeyThere, you can add a group chat...
• ...at your favorite hangout for easily planning a night out
• ...at your gym for setting up group games and events
• ...at your business to notify customers of deals and specials

Any group you make is only joinable where you made it. Once you're in the group, you can stay in wherever you go. Use it as a social app to see what's happening around you, or write a review in a group chat at your favorite restaurant. HeyThere provides you with relevant content about whats happening around you. 
 

Safety
Safety is our highest priority, so we've made sure to include features like blocking, muting, and reporting users.
